$comment: Written by `procedures:write`; held by its drift test. Do not edit by hand.

accept.typesUnique: no media type is listed twice in allowedTypes

accept.typesOnce: no media type is listed twice in allowedTypes

accept.missingOnlyWhileBlank: the missing key is named exactly while the batch size is blank

request_once.says: a request appears once in a batch

input.summary: The customer asks about a deposit.

accept.countsAddUp: counts are not negative, the five scores add up to the responses, no more responses than requests solved, and the rated share is blank exactly when nothing was solved (at most 10000 basis points)

support_scam_report_input_holds.says: a report after sending money names the transfer; before sending money there is no transfer to name

amount_holds.says: an amount is greater than zero

oneSetting.says: at least one of maxBytes, allowedTypes and maxCount is given

typesOnce.says: no media type is listed twice

mediaType.says: each entry is a lower-case media type with no wildcard or parameter, such as image/png

accept.typesOnce: no media type is listed twice in allowedTypes

oneChannel.says: at least one of email, phone and chatHours is given

channelReads.says: a channel given as text is one email address, a phone number of at least five digits, or chat hours a visitor reads

accept.windowOnlyWhenSet: automatic offline is set exactly when the window has a value

desk_panels_hold.says: each panel id once, and no two panels on one cell

desk_panel_settings_fit.says: settings stay under 4096 characters as JSON

desk_panel_on_grid.says: the panel sits inside the grid columns and rows

accept.codeOnlyWhenWaiting: the no-agent code is present exactly when no agent could take the request

support_view_cap_holds.says: a cap is a number or a missing setting, not both and not neither
